description: A utility Android IntentService class handling background operations such as geofencing, location updates, notifications, and data transfer to wearables for the XYZTouristAttractions app.

classes.name: UtilityService
classes.description: An Android IntentService for handling background tasks such as geofencing, location updates, notifications, and data transfer to wearables in the XYZTouristAttractions app.

methods.name: getLocationUpdatedIntentFilter
methods.description: Returns an IntentFilter for location update broadcasts.

methods.name: triggerWearTest
methods.description: Triggers a fake update/test for wearable integration.

methods.name: addGeofences
methods.description: Starts the process to add geofences via Google Play Services.

methods.name: getClearRemoteNotificationsIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to clear remote notifications on wearables.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Main handler for incoming intents, dispatching to specific background operations.

methods.name: addGeofencesInternal
methods.description: Adds geofences using Google Play Services API.

methods.name: geofenceTriggered
methods.description: Handles geofence transition events, triggering notifications or clearing them.

methods.name: requestLocationInternal
methods.description: Requests the device's current location and updates.

methods.name: locationUpdated
methods.description: Handles location update broadcasts, stores location, and sends local broadcast.

methods.name: clearRemoteNotifications
methods.description: Sends messages to connected wearables to clear notifications.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a notification about nearby attractions, optionally as a micro app.

methods.name: sendDataToWearable
methods.description: Transfers attraction data to connected wearables via DataApi.
